content: Emaho!In the realm of the dharmadhātu, free from conceptual elaboration,Within the state of the nature of reality, beyond arising or ceasing in the three times,Is the embodiment of great bliss, spontaneously perfect and free from activity;Like the vast sky, your compassion is without partiality.To the Guru, the Dharmakāya, I pray.In the spontaneously present realm of Great Bliss,Possessing the body, speech, mind, qualities, and activities,The Sugata-kaya endowed with the five wisdoms,Displays various distinct aspects of compassion;To the Guru, the Sambhogakāya, I pray.Into this pure realm of the Sahā world,You have come through great compassion for the sake of beings;You benefit wanderers through skillful means, taming each according to their needs;Of the three times—past, future, and present—To the Guru, the Nirmāṇakāya, I pray.To the Dharmakāya Samantabhadra, I pray.To the Sambhogakāya, the Victors of the five families, I pray.To the Nirmāṇakāya, the Protectors of the three families, I pray.To the master from Oḍḍiyāna, Padmasambhava, I pray.To the bhikṣu Namkhai Nyingpo, I pray.To the Dharma King Trisong Detsen, I pray.To the ḍākinī Yeshe Tsogyal, I pray.To Nanam Dorje Dudjom, I pray.To the Prince Mutri Tsenpo, I pray.To the vidyādhara Gargyi Wangchuk, I pray.To Mipham Chökyi Gyalpo, I pray.To Mipham Tenpé Nyima, I pray.To the son of the Victors, Ngawang Namgyal, I pray.To my kind root Guru, I pray.Please bestow the supreme and common accomplishments.Emaho!Within the wondrous and inconceivable teachings of the Buddha,Three exceptionally sublime dispensations have appeared;Within the teachings of the Buddha Śākyamuni,The teachings of the Great Vehicle Secret Mantra have appeared;To these precious teachings, I pray.In the spontaneously present realm of Akaniṣṭha,Through the enlightened intent of the Sugatas of the three times,Because of the rebellion against the command by Mātraṃ Rudra,You behold the sentient beings of the six realms, exhausted by suffering;To your extraordinary compassion, I pray.In the sacred palace of Alakāvatī,All the Tathāgatas held a consultation;Through the four activities of pacifying, enriching, magnetizing, and subjugating,You act to subdue the perverted teachings of the māras;To the Sugatas of the three times, I pray.At the summit of Mount Malaya, where meteoric iron blazes,The demon Mātraṃ Rudra was fiercely liberated;Union was practiced with the assemblies of the rākṣasī,From which the Secret Mantra teachings first arose;To these extraordinary beings to be tamed, I pray.In the palace of the Dharmadhātu of Akaniṣṭha,The Dharmakāya, beyond arising and ceasing throughout the three times,All phenomena are primordially pure and spontaneously present;The Father who is generated from the wisdom-mind of all Buddhas,To the Dharmakāya Samantabhadra, I pray.In the spontaneously present realm of Great Bliss,Within the state of mirror-like wisdom, the purity of delusion,The Body of Vairocana, perfect in conduct,Is the supreme Body Family, surrounded by a retinue of the same family;To the assembly of deities of the Buddha Family, I pray.In the eastern realm of Abhirati,Within the state of mirror-like wisdom, the purity of anger,Vajrasattva, the Sambhogakāya,Is the supreme Mind Family, surrounded by a retinue of the same family;To the assembly of deities of the Vajra Family, I pray.In the southern realm of Śrīmat, the Glorious and Beautiful,Within the state of the Wisdom of Equality, the purity of pride,Ratnasambhava, the Sambhogakāya,Is the supreme Quality Family, surrounded by a retinue of the same family;To the assembly of deities of the Ratna Family, I pray.In the western realm of Sukhāvatī,Within the state of discriminating wisdom, the purity of attachment,Amitābha, the Sambhogakāya,Is the supreme Speech Family, surrounded by a retinue of the same family;To the assembly of deities of the Padma Family, I pray.In the northern realm of Karmaprasiddhi,Within the state of all-accomplishing wisdom, the purity of jealousy,Amoghasiddhi, the Sambhogakāya,Is the supreme Action Family, surrounded by a retinue of the same family;To the assembly of deities of the Karma Family, I pray.In the great celestial mansion of the play of Dharmadhātu,Upon a seat of the crushed five poisonous afflictions,The king of wrathful ones, the supreme Chemchok Heruka,Is surrounded by a retinue of the gathered Sugatas of the five families;To the assembly of deities of Samantabhadra Heruka, I pray.In the great celestial mansion of the display of compassion,Upon a seat of the trampled arrogant māmo and māra demons,The king of perfect manifestation, the supreme Chemchok Heruka,Is surrounded by a retinue of māmos formed from primordial wisdom;To the assembly of deities of Chemchok Mamo, I pray.In the blazing, dark-blue triangular celestial mansion,Upon a seat of the trampled Matram Rudra,The embodiment of compassion, Vajra Heruka,Is surrounded by a retinue of blazing, blood-drinking wrathful ones;To the assembly of deities of the Great Glorious Heruka, I pray.Within the dark-blue wrathful celestial mansion arising from the syllable E,Upon a seat of the trampled Lord of Death and water buffalo,Mañjuśrī Yamāntaka, the Slayer of Death,Is surrounded by a retinue of wrathful executioners and arrogant spirits;To the assembly of deities of Mañjuśrī Yamāntaka, I pray.In the dark-red triangular celestial mansion of power,Upon a seat of trampled male and female black demons,The King of Power, Padma Heruka,Is surrounded by the wrathful deities of the Lotus family;To the assembly of deities of Hayagrīva, Lord of Power, I pray.In the celestial mansion blazing like the fire at the end of an eon,Upon a seat of trampled arrogant male demons,The heroic body of the Great Glorious Vajrakumāra,Is surrounded by a retinue of the ten wrathful subduers of demons and the Tratap deities;To the assembly of deities of Vajrakīla, I pray.In the great celestial mansion of the Lotus of Power,Upon a seat of a blazing, non-attached lotus,The Bhagavan Protector, Wisdom Amitāyus,Is surrounded by the assembly of deities of immortal life;To the assembly of deities of Vajra Longevity, I pray.In the celestial mansion of the majestic and terrifying charnel ground,Upon a seat of trampled prostrate corpses,The body of the Great Mother, the wrathful Vajravārāhī,Is surrounded by a retinue of various mamos and ḍākinīs;To the assembly of deities of Vajrayoginī, I pray.In the palace of Vajrāsana in India,Working for the benefit of beings through the truth of cause and effect,Hoisting the victory banner of the teachings of the Tripitaka,Surrounded by a retinue of Śrāvakas and Bodhisattvas;To the Nirmāṇakāya Śākyamuni, I pray.In the naga palace of Dhanakośa,You came through the power of compassion for the benefit of beings;With the Victor’s realization, you enacted the self-liberation of the six classes of beings,Surrounded by a retinue of mamos and ḍākinīs of the five families;To the Nirmāṇakāya Garab Dorje, I pray.In the palace of Mount Wutai in China,Mañjughoṣa, the emanation of the Buddha’s body,Acts for the benefit of beings through his form in the four directions, above and below,Surrounded by a retinue of Bodhisattvas of the Body;To the assembly of deities of the noble Mañjuśrī, I pray.In the palace of Mount Potala,Avalokiteśvara, the emanation of the Buddha’s speech,Acts for the benefit of beings through his speech in the four directions, above and below,Surrounded by a retinue of Bodhisattvas of the Speech;To the assembly of deities of Avalokiteśvara, I pray.In the supreme palace of Alakāvatī,Vajrapāṇi, the emanation of the Buddha’s mind,Acts for the benefit of beings through his mind in the four directions, above and below,Surrounded by a retinue of Bodhisattvas of the Mind;To the assembly of deities of Vajrapāṇi, I pray.In the Victorious Mansion of the upper realms,Through the wisdom intention of the noble Mañjuśrī,The Secret Mantra appeared in the abode of Indra, Lord of the Devas;Together with a hundred thousand in the assembly, he attained manifest buddhahood;To the divine Vidyādharas, I pray.In the dark depths of the great ocean below,Through the wisdom intention of the noble Avalokiteśvara,The Secret Mantra appeared in the abode of the Naga King Jogpo;Together with a hundred thousand in the assembly, he attained manifest buddhahood;To the naga Vidyādharas, I pray.Upon the summit of the King of Mountains, the Blazing Volcano,Through the wisdom intention of Vajrapāṇi,The Secret Mantra appeared in the abode of King Dza;All fortunate individuals attained enlightenment;To the human Vidyādharas, I pray.In the Magnetizing Palace of Oḍḍiyāna in the west,You are the emanation of the body, speech, and mind of the Sugatas;You came to the world of Jambudvīpa for the benefit of beings,Surrounded by a retinue of many vidyādharas and ḍākinīs;To the assembly of deities of Padmasambhava, I pray.Dharmakāya, Sambhogakāya, Nirmāṇakāya, and further emanations,Of the three times—past, future, and present—To all the Buddhas of the ten directions without exception,With the devotion of our body, speech, and mind,We pray without any doubt or hesitation.Emaho!From here, in the direction of the southwest,To the west of the great sacred site of Vajrāsana,On the subcontinent of Ngayab, the land of the flesh-eating rākṣasas,Blessed by the Buddhas of the three times,To that supreme and extraordinary island, I pray.Hūṃ!In the time when the first eon of the past had passed,From the eight substances of the liberated Mātraṃ Rudra,Eight sites for the emergence of the Secret Mantra were blessed;As the citta descended to the land of Oḍḍiyāna,To that extraordinary auspicious connection, I pray.A place blessed by Vajravārāhī,An island where all mamos and ḍākinīs assemble,Where the natural sound of the Secret Mantra resounds *diri-ri*,Merely by reaching that place, enlightenment is attained;To that supreme and extraordinary sacred place, I pray.The Glorious Copper-Colored Mountain is in the shape of a heart;Its base is firmly planted in the realm of the naga kings;Its middle stands majestic in the stable abode of the ḍākinīs;Its peak seems to reach toward the world of Brahmā;To that extraordinary king of mountains, I pray.Upon the summit of the blazing Glorious Mountain,The east is crystal, the south is vaiḍūrya,The west is rāga, and the north is the color of indra;A celestial mansion, luminous without interior or exterior;To that extraordinary palace, I pray.The four directions and eight intermediate points of that celestial mansion,And all above and below, are constructed of precious jewels;Its corridors, corners, and four types of projections,Clearly display the distinct colors of the four activities;To that spontaneously present celestial mansion, I pray.The walls, offering ledges, friezes, and lattices,The half-lattices and eaves shine with five types of jewels;The four gates, archways, Dharma wheels, and all ornaments,Are beautifully adorned with various precious gems;To that precious celestial mansion, I pray.Wish-fulfilling trees and springs of nectar,Five-colored rainbows gather like clouds inside and out;The light of lotus flowers fills the atmosphere,Merely by remembering that place, great bliss is attained;To that celestial mansion of Lotus Light, I pray.Within that great celestial mansion,Upon a precious eight-faceted throne of sun and moon,On a stem of a blazing, non-attached lotus,Is Padmasambhava, embodiment of the assembly of Sugatas;To that self-arisen Nirmanakaya, I pray.To contemplate the purpose of peaceful, increasing, magnetizing, and wrathful activities,Though your body color, hand symbols, and ornaments are not fixed,Your majestic brilliance is greater than the light of a thousand suns;You are even more magnificent than the king of mountains, Mount Meru;To that wondrous Nirmanakaya, I pray.Your emanations fill the entire world,Your eyes swirl and gaze like the sun and moon;Your compassionate activity is swifter than lightning in the sky,Your profound realization is equal to the expanse of space;To that extraordinary compassionate one, I pray.Through love for beings, you act for their benefit with skillful means,Your smiling face glows with a beautiful, shimmering radiance;The resonance of your speech is louder than a thousand thunders,The Dharma-sound of the profound Secret Mantra vibrates intensely;To you who proclaim the melody of Brahma’s voice, I pray.In the four directions and eight intermediate points of the great Nirmanakaya,Upon seats where perverted enemies and obstructors are trampled,The hosts of the five families of Sugatas and demon-subduing wrathful ones,Manifesting as body, speech, mind, qualities, and enlightened activity,To the assembly of deities of the Eight Great Heruka Mandalas, I pray.Upon the seats of four-petalled lotuses in the four directions,The hosts of the four families of ging and the five classes of ḍākinīs,All without exception, adorned with the ornaments of the charnel grounds,Reside in beautiful attire and in the posture of playful dance;To the wisdom ḍākinīs in union with their consorts, I pray.In the four directions and corridors of the great celestial mansion,The corners and alcoves are filled with Vidyādharas and Ḍākinīs;Multitudes of gods and goddesses gather like massing clouds,Presenting various outer, inner, and secret offerings;To the assembly of deities of the Mamos and Ḍākinīs, I pray.Within the precious celestial mansion of sensory delights,Offering goddesses gather like massing rain clouds;The world is filled with offerings of the six sensory pleasures,Worshipping the Sugatas with the offerings of Samantabhadra;To the assembly of deities, the source of all enlightened qualities, I pray.At the four gates in the four directions of the great celestial mansion,The Four Great Kings act as the obedient servants of your command;The eight classes of gods and demons are dispatched as servants and messengers,Subduing Māras and heretics as if they were mere particles of dust;To the assembly of deities of the Dharma protectors and guardians, I pray.Hūṃ!Arise, Padmasambhava and the hosts of ḍākinīs!Turn your enlightened intent toward us, Sugatas of the ten directions and three times!Great Noble One, Padma Thötreng Tsal,We pray you come from the realm of vidyādharas and ḍākinīs!Your beautiful hair, bound in a topknot, shimmers and flows;Many precious ornaments are tinkling and jingling;Charnel ground bone ornaments are clattering and rattling;Many sounds and musical melodies are roaring and resounding.The assembly of Yidam deities resounds with the vibrating sound of Hūṃ;The five classes of ḍākinīs dance with swaying and shimmering movements;The great Ging warriors stomp their rhythmic dance—khrabs se khrab;The mamos and ḍākinīs gather like dense, swirling clouds.The eight classes of Dharma protectors and their emissaries dart with lightning speed—khyug se khyug;The sound of a thousand great coats of mail rings out—si li li;On the right, all the masculine lineages swirl—sha ra ra;On the left, all the feminine lineages swirl—sha ra ra.Throughout the atmosphere, silk parasols flutter and wave—lhab se lhab;The sweet fragrance of incense wafts and swirls—thu lu lu;The secret symbolic language of the ḍākinīs resounds—di ri ri;The whistling songs of the great Ging warriors ring out—kyu ru ru.The many resonant melodies of Hūṃ vibrate—di ri ri;The fierce symbolic cry of Phaṭ rings out—sang se sang;Upon myself and all sentient beings of the six realms,Look with compassion, and I pray you come to this place.Consider us with compassion and come to this place;Until we attain the heart of enlightenment,Subdue all obstacles, misleading influences, and hindrances,And please bestow the supreme and common accomplishments;Please deliver us from the ocean of the suffering of saṃsāra.Emaho!Samantabhadra, the Victorious One of great bliss free from conceptual elaboration,Vajradhara, the sixth Buddha of the five families,Bodhisattva, who acts for the benefit of the six classes of beings,The three forms of Dharmakāya, Sambhogakāya, and Nirmāṇakāya—To the Victors of the mind lineage, I offer my supplication.The famous Drakden Chokkyong, the Yakṣa Karmadadong,Lodrö Thabden, the Nāga King Jogpo,Drime Drakpa, and the fortunate King Ja,The Vidyādhara Indra, Lord of the Gods, and others—To the Vidyādhara lineage of pure awareness, I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Dharmakāya Samantabhadra,Vajrasattva, Garab Dorje, andDown to Śrī Siṃha, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the Dzogchen lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Victorious Dharmakāya,The Sugatas of the five families and the Lords of the three families,Down to Buddhaguhya, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the Gyutrul lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Mañjuśrī Yamāntaka,The great master Mañjuśrīmitra andDown to Rolang Dewa, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the Mañjuśrī lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Padma Heruka,The magnetizing goddess, Nāgārjuna, andDown to Padmasambhava, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the speech lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Vajra Heruka,Garab Dorje, Mañjuśrīmitra, andDown to the great Hūṃkara, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the mind lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Chemchok Heruka,Many emanated ḍākinīs and vidyādharas, andThe unchanging vidyādharas of space were blessed;To the masters of the quality lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Great Glorious Vajrakumāra,The vidyādharas of spontaneously present Mahāmudrā andDorje Thötreng Tsal were blessed;To the masters of the enlightened activity lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.The King of Manifest Perfection, Chemchok Heruka,The Mother Lineage, the Goddess who embraces all, and Dema,Down to Dhanasaṃskṛta, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the Mother Lineage of existence of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Bhagavan, Subduer of All Arrogant Spirits,From the mind-lineage of Raṃbu Guhya Candra,Down to Śākya Senge, the blessings were bestowed;To the masters of the offering and praise lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Great Glorious Powerful Black One,From the mind-lineage of the master Śiṃtaṃ Gandha,Blessings were bestowed upon Dorje Drolö Tsal;To the masters of the wrathful mantra lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Protector Amitāyus,From the mind-lineage of the Goddess Caṇḍālī,Blessings were bestowed upon the deathless Padmasambhava;To the Vidyādharas of longevity of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Vajravārāhī,From the mind-lineage of the Lion-Faced Ḍākinī,Blessings were bestowed upon Dorje Drakpo Tsal;To the masters of the mother-tantra lineage of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of Vajra Heruka,From the mind-lineage of the Nirmāṇakāya Padmasambhava,Blessings were bestowed upon the fortunate ones of Tibet and the world;To the masters of the gathered lineage of the Secret Mantra of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Buddhas of the past,From the mind-lineage of the Buddha Śākyamuni,Blessings were bestowed down through the Bodhisattvas;To the masters who reveal the meaning of cause and effect of the three times—Past, future, and present—I offer my supplication.Through the enlightened intent of the Vidyādharas and Bodhisattvas,Blessings were bestowed upon the fortunate individuals;From this time until the end of the final five hundred years,To those who hold the samaya of practicing the Secret Mantra as commanded,To the masters of the oral lineage of individuals—I offer my supplication.Whatever appears to the scope of the eyes,All outer and inner appearances, the environment and its inhabitants,Rest within the state where they appear yet are free from grasping at reality;The purity of subject and object is the deity’s body of clarity and emptiness;To the Guru of self-liberated desire—I offer my supplication.Whatever resonates within the scope of the ears,All sounds, whether pleasant or unpleasant, that one grasps,Rest within the state of resonant emptiness, free from conceptual thought;Resonant emptiness, without arising or ceasing, is the speech of the Victors;To the Guru of resonant, empty speech—I offer my supplication.Whatever movements arise as objects of the mind,Whatever thoughts of the five poisonous afflictions appear,Do not modify them with a mind that anticipates or analyzes;By letting movement rest in its own place, it is liberated as the Dharmakāya;To the Guru of self-liberated awareness—I offer my supplication.As the external appearances of apprehended objects are purified,As the inner perceiving mind itself is liberated,And as the clear light in between is recognized for what it is,Through the compassion of the Sugatas of the three times,Grant your blessings that the mindstream of one such as me may be liberated.Emaho!In the southwestern subcontinent of Ngayab, the land of the Rākṣasas,Upon an island in the Sindhu Ocean,Atop the palace where the Nāga King Takṣaka dwells,You were born from the tip of a blazing lotus stalk;To you, the self-arisen and wondrous one, I offer my supplication.Emanation body, a youth without father or mother,Who appeared from the expanse of the ocean without cause or condition,Glorious guide for sentient beings lost in the darkness of ignorance,You are the emanation of the body, speech, and mind of the Sugatas;To the Nirmanakaya, Lake-Born Vajra, I offer my supplication.The fortunate King Indrabhūti,Found you upon an island in the great ocean and brought you forth;With faith he invited you and enthroned you as king,Establishing the realm in happiness through the laws of Dharma;To the King with the Topknot, I offer my supplication.In the Cool Grove charnel ground of the south,Renouncing the kingdom, you engaged in ascetic conduct;Through the realization of the union and liberation of Tanagana,You brought all the mamos and ḍākinīs under your power;To Śāntarakṣita, I offer my supplication.You practiced in all the charnel grounds of the four directions,You were blessed by the wisdom ḍākinīs,You beheld the face of Vajravārāhī and attained accomplishments,You brought all the great planetary spirits of the sky under your service;To Dorje Drakpo Tsal, I offer my supplication.In the cave of the Red Rock Garuda Grove,You went into the presence of the master Prabhahasti;You trained in the teachings of Yoga Tantra,And having beheld the faces of the Yoga deity assemblies,To the form of Śākya Senge, I offer my supplication.In the great sacred sites of the four directions of India,You went into the presence of many vidyādharas and accomplished masters;You trained in the teachings of the three yogas,And cut through misconceptions regarding the causal vehicles of dialectics;To Loden Choksé, I offer my supplication.In the cave of Māratika,When you accomplished the vidyādhara of immortal life,You were blessed by the Protector Amitāyus,And transformed into a deathless vajra body;To the immortal Padmākara, I offer my supplication.When you went to subdue the kingdom of Zahor,You established sentient beings, deluded by ignorance, in the Dharma;You displayed wondrous and marvelous miracles,And filled the entire kingdom with the Dharma;To the form of Padmasambhava, I offer my supplication.When you went to subdue the kingdom of Oḍḍiyāna,And were burned in the midst of fire by the executioners,You displayed the miracle of transforming the mass of flames into a lake;You established Indrabodhi on the path to enlightenment;To the supreme son, Padma Gyalpo, I offer my supplication.In the Akaniṣṭha realm and the charnel ground of Great Bliss,In the Lhundrup Tsek and Pema Tsek, and others,When you resided before the self-arisen stūpas,You turned the wheel of Dharma for the mamos and ḍākinīs;To Guru Nyima Özer, I offer my supplication.When you went to subdue the land of Southern India,You were blessed by the ḍākinī Düdülma;You repelled the debates of five hundred non-Buddhist teachers,And liberated the masters of evil mantras and heretics with a thunderbolt;To the noble Sengé Dradok, I offer my supplication.In the rock cave of Yangleshö in Nepal,When you practiced the essence of the perfect Great Bliss,You liberated all obstacles and obstructing spirits with the vajra dagger;You attained the siddhi of Mahāmudrā in that very place;To Dorje Thötreng Tsal, I offer my supplication.When you traveled to the north for the sake of the King,You bound all the yakṣas of Tibet under oath;You consecrated Samye and fulfilled the King’s intentions,And made the entire land of Tibet filled with the Dharma;To the Nirmāṇakāya Padmasambhava, I offer my supplication.In the rock cave of Chimpu at Samyé,Within the secret mantra maṇḍala of the Eight Great Sādhanas,You brought the fortunate King and his subjects to maturation,And caused the teachings of the Resultant Secret Mantra to flourish;To the one whose kindness is beyond conception, I offer my supplication.In the cave of Taktsang Sengé Samdrub,You subdued the malicious heretics, demons, and oath-breaking spirits;You concealed great treasures in the major sacred sites of snow mountains and cliffs;With compassion, you behold the sentient beings of the future degenerate age;To Dorje Drolö Tsal, I offer my supplication.You established places of practice at the four great snow mountains of Tibet;You practiced in seclusion within the eight great rock caves;You left the footprints of your nirmāṇakāya on the cliffs of the four directions;You left your handprints at the four famous great lakes;To you who purifies the obscurations of the six classes of beings, I offer my supplication.You left the imprint of your body on the rocks of Mönkha in the south;You left five representative treasures for the sake of Tibet;You caused the Buddha’s teachings to flourish to their furthest extent;Sole deity of Tibet, glory of all living beings;To you of extraordinary compassion, I offer my supplication.On the peak of the Glorious Mountain on the southwestern subcontinent of Ngayab,Surrounded by a retinue of many vidyādharas and ḍākinīs,You bound all the flesh-eating rākṣasas under oath;With compassion, you gaze upon Tibet without interruption;To you, the most gracious nirmāṇakāya, I offer my supplication.In this final five-hundred-year period, for the sentient beings of Tibet,Suffering is unceasing due to the power of negative karma;As I remember your life of liberation and offer this prayer,Upon myself and all sentient beings of the six realms,Please look with compassion and grant your blessings.Emaho!In the western realm of Sukhāvatī,Through the compassion of the Protector Amitāyus,You consider the welfare of beings in the world of Jambudvīpa;Blessed by the Buddhas of the ten directions,I pray to the Sugatas of the three times.Upon the island in the playful Sindhu Ocean,Upon a stalk of a blazing lotus flower,Without father or mother, you appeared through spontaneous power;Without cause or condition, you came for the sake of beings,To the self-arisen, wondrous one, I pray.You are the emanation of the bodies of all the Buddhas,Naturally appearing, you came endowed with the major and minor marks;Your majestic brilliance is greater than the light of a thousand suns,Your emanations fill the world in its entirety;To the wondrous Nirmanakaya, I pray.You are the emanation of the speech of all the Buddhas,Born upon the peak of a blazing, non-attached lotus;Your melodic voice is greater than the roar of a thousand great dragons,Proclaiming the sound of the Mahāyāna Dharma for the benefit of beings;To the speech that resounds like thunder, I pray.You are the emanation of the mind of all the Buddhas,Born from the expanse of the bottomless and boundless ocean;Your compassionate activity is swifter than lightning in the sky,Your profound realization is equal to the limits of space;To the mind that is vividly aware of all, I pray.You are the wish-fulfilling jewel for the benefit of beings,Merely hearing your name dispels all suffering;Your qualities appear distinctly, like a rainbow,Remembering you for an instant leads one to the path of enlightenment;To you, the source of all excellent qualities, I pray.Through the power of compassion and enlightened activity, you work for the benefit of beings;With the four activities of pacifying, enriching, magnetizing, and wrathful taming,You skillfully subdue those sentient beings whose afflictions are difficult to tame;Your enlightened activities are as inconceivable as the stars in the sky;To the waves of the ocean of enlightened activity, I pray.Although you work for the benefit of beings in the four directions, above and below,You gaze with compassion upon the Land of Snows, Tibet;To all the sovereign and subjects of Tibet,Grant your blessings continuously throughout the three times;Please
